description: This file defines the trait AsyncLogPurge, which provides asynchronous log purging capabilities within Spark's streaming runtime. It manages background thread execution for purging logs and stateful metadata, with methods for initiating, checking, and shutting down async purge operations.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Abstract method to purge logs based on a threshold.

methods.name: purgeStatefulMetadata
methods.description: Abstract method to purge stateful metadata files.

methods.name: purgeAsync
methods.description: Initiates asynchronous log purging if not already running.

methods.name: purgeStatefulMetadataAsync
methods.description: Initiates asynchronous stateful metadata purging if not already running.

methods.name: asyncLogPurgeShutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the async purge executor service.

methods.name: arePendingAsyncPurge
methods.description: Checks if there are any pending or active async purge operations.
